content: shadcn/ui has no single DatePicker component -- it's a documented composition pattern: Popover + Calendar (built on react-day-picker) + a Button trigger showing the formatted date via date-fns. Wire it into react-hook-form with Controller/FormField: Calendar's onSelect maps to field.onChange, Calendar's selected prop reads field.value. Needs 'npx shadcn add popover calendar button' plus 'date-fns' -- none of these are installed in this repo yet.
